Standard_Hoofed_Forelegs.description: These robust, hoofed forelegs, characteristic of powerful quadrupeds, enhance the creature's strength and speed, granting it the ability to execute a devastating charge that can break through even the most formidable defenses.

Cloven_Hoofed_Forelegs.description: Equipped with the sinuous grace of a cloven hoofed forelegs, these powerful limbs grant an unparalleled agility and a swift speed bonus, allowing their bearer to traverse treacherous terrains with ease and perform acrobatic feats with fluid elegance.

Heavy_Draft_Hooves.description: Enormous, cloven hooves tipped with thick, calloused pads, these powerful limbs are built for endurance and brute force, their heavy tread capable of flattening underbrush and leaving deep, lasting impressions in the earth, while also granting their owner the ability to resist being knocked over or pushed aside.

Padded_Camel_Forelegs.description: The padded camel forelegs, with their robust yet flexible design, grant unparalleled stability and grace, enhancing the wearer's constitution and agility as they traverse challenging terrains with ease, ignoring the usual penalties for rough or steep environments.

Slender_Gazelle_Legs.description: Equipped with slender gazelle legs, the wearer gains unparalleled agility and speed, bounding across terrain with the grace and power of a swift ungulate, capable of performing acrobatic leaps and sprints that leave enemies in the dust.

Rhino_Pillar_Legs.description: The Rhino_Pillar_Legs are massive, sturdily-built legs that resemble the sturdy pillars of an ancient ruin, brimming with raw strength and imbued with an innate resilience, though they slow the creature's pace with each ponderous step.

Tapir_Stocky_Forelegs.description: Brawny and robust, these stocky forelegs are adapted for immense strength and endurance, enhancing the quadruped's constitution and strength, allowing it to traverse rugged terrains with unyielding resolve and prowess.

Hippopotamus_Stout_Webbed_Legs.description: Brawny and resilient, the stout webbed legs of this creature bulge with powerful muscles, granting unparalleled strength and endurance, while their natural form lends itself perfectly to both terrestrial and aquatic environments, where they can unleash devastating blocks and swift swimming dashes.

Zombie_Boar_Rotting_Legs.description: Battered by the relentless ravages of decay, the zombie boar's legs are a twisted amalgamation of rotting flesh and sinew, granting it an eerie resilience and a sluggish, ground-shaking gait that leaves a trail of toxic miasma in its wake.

Ghost_Stallion_Ethereal_Legs.description: The Ghost Stallion's ethereal legs are a marvel of spectral magic, allowing it to hover effortlessly over any terrain, its gaunt, translucent limbs barely touching the ground, granting it an otherworldly grace and an uncanny ability to evade detection.
